Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. The work:

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will play a meaningful role helping to advance Ripple's production infrastructure and release pipelines. Senior Platform Engineers at Ripple are a hybrid of systems and software engineers who support the design and lifecycle of our hosted products. You will work closely with product engineers to provide mentorship, automation, and development of platform features!

What you'll do:

  • Deploy and maintain Ripple’s multi-region, multi-provider service platforms (with an emphasis on security and resiliency)
  • Develop tools for automation, monitoring, and instrumentation to reduce operational friction and increase engineering efficiency
  • Design, build, and evolve a scalable hub-and-spoke network architecture including route domain segmentation, inter-region peering, and centralized inspection and egress patterns.
  • Build solutions for outstanding technical challenges faced by Ripple involving PKI, secret management, geographic failover, data replication, availability, and platform resiliency
  • Architect private service connectivity across accounts and VPCs, using private endpoint and service-to-service networking patterns that expose services without public internet exposure or complex peering.
  • Design and maintain DNS for a multi-account environment, including private hosted zones, conditional forwarding, and consistent naming standards across teams.
  • Lead Kubernetes networking design, including CNI configuration, ingress and egress control, network policies, service discovery, and service mesh integration.
  • Build and automate new and existing platform and application lifecycle services, using data to converge on declared states with minimal human interaction

  • Experience developing APIs and SDKs

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

To help support that mission, in August we announced that Stripe had agreed to acquire OpenRouter, a leading AI model gateway and routing platform. While that acquisition is under regulatory review and has not yet closed, our intent is that this role will support the OpenRouter team following the closing of the acquisition.

About the team

OpenRouter helps developers and businesses access and use a broad range of AI models through a unified platform. This role sits at the intersection of OpenRouter and Stripe, supporting hiring across Tech, GTM, and Core teams. You’ll serve as a bridge between the 2 organizations, bringing Stripe’s recruiting standards, talent networks, and resources to OpenRouter while protecting its speed and minimizing operational overhead.

You’ll align to Tech, GTM, or Core, but you won’t be dedicated to a single job profile within that function. For example, a GTM Recruiter may support Sales, Solutions Architecture, Marketing, or other GTM roles as priorities shift. The same model applies across Tech and Core.

What you’ll do

Own full-cycle recruiting for your aligned function, moving across job profiles based on business priority, from intake and market mapping through offer acceptance and onboarding handoff. You’ll combine direct execution with consultative partnership, working closely with hiring managers to clarify needs, advise on talent markets, build and engage qualified pipelines, and move candidates through structured, timely processes.

You’ll operate with startup speed while leveraging Stripe’s infrastructure and reach. You’ll use metrics to identify risk and guide action, while keeping recruiting outcomes, not reporting or process for its own sake, at the center of the work.

Responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle recruiting across the full range of roles within your aligned function, Tech, GTM, or Core, moving between job profiles as business priorities shift
  • Build qualified and inclusive pipelines through hands-on sourcing across communities, referrals, events, market mapping, relationship-based outreach, and other creative channels beyond inbound applications and standard LinkedIn outreach
  • Partner consultatively with hiring managers to translate business priorities into clear role requirements, search strategies, structured assessments, and timely decisions
  • Use funnel metrics, market evidence, and candidate feedback to identify risks, recommend actions, and communicate progress without allowing reporting or process to substitute for recruiting
  • Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience and maintain relationships with prospective candidates for immediate and future needs
  • Serve as an operational bridge between OpenRouter and Stripe by absorbing coordination where possible, maintaining continuity, and reducing the time OpenRouter leaders spend navigating recruiting processes

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including direct ownership of sourcing, assessment, stakeholder partnership, and closing
  • Experience recruiting in a high-growth technology startup, preferably during a stage below 200 employees
  • Demonstrated recruiting depth in at least 1 of the following areas: Tech, GTM, or Core, with experience recruiting across multiple job profiles or clear evidence you can move between profiles as business priorities shift.
  • Demonstrated interest in and ability to personally conduct hands-on sourcing and build qualified pipelines through creative channels beyond inbound applications and standard LinkedIn outreach
  • Experience partnering consultatively with hiring managers, managing multiple searches, and using recruiting metrics and market evidence to identify risk and guide action
  • Ability to work through ambiguity, adapt quickly as priorities change, and balance direct execution with longer-term pipeline building

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience recruiting across both startup and larger-company environments and helping teams work effectively across different operating models
  • Experience supporting structured, competency-based hiring processes
  • Experience recruiting across multiple geographies or advising on location strategy
  • Practical experience using recruiting technology, talent intelligence, or AI tools to improve sourcing and candidate experience

About us

BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.

We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.

Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.

Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.

By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.

We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:

  • CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
  • FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
  • Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
  • LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

Location: We offer a Hybrid/Remote working policy.

FUNCTION: Product

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Fiat product team and own the operational backbone of our fiat payment flows.

Every day, BVNK moves money for enterprise customers across SEPA, SWIFT, ACH, RTGS and instant payment schemes. Getting a payment out of the door is only half the job. What happens next (a return, a recall, a rejected payment, a compliance hold, an investigation or a customer query) is where trust is won or lost. Your mission is to make those processes fast, reliable, automated and compliant, at scale.

You'll own the product strategy for the post-initiation and exception lifecycle of fiat payments: returns, recalls, rejections, repairs, investigations, compliance-driven holds and releases, and the tooling our operations teams use to manage them. You'll work hand in hand with payment operations, compliance, financial crime, treasury, finance and our banking partners to turn manual processes into well-designed product capabilities.

You'll partner with senior product managers, engineers and architects and with small, autonomous engineering squads, and you'll take products from discovery and design all the way through to launch. We see AI as a key lever in how we build and operate, and we expect you to use it in your day-to-day work.

Key Areas of Responsibilities:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for FIAT payment operations, covering the full exception lifecycle of payment flows across all schemes we support: SEPA (SCT and SCT Inst), SWIFT, ACH, Fedwire, FedNow, RTP and Faster Payments.
  • Design and deliver scheme-compliant handling of returns, recalls, rejections, cancellations, payment repairs and investigations, including the related ISO 20022 messages (e.g. pacs.004, camt.056, camt.029) and their equivalents on non-ISO rails.
  • Build compliance processes into payment flows from the start: sanctions and transaction screening outcomes, holds and releases, Requests for Information (RFIs), Verification of Payee / Confirmation of Payee, Travel Rule and fraud-related recalls, working closely with Operation, compliance and financial crime teams.
  • Drive straight-through processing and automation. Reduce manual intervention, define clear exception queues and SLAs, and give operations teams the internal tools, workflows and visibility they need.
  • Ensure the ledger, reconciliation, treasury and reporting stay correct when a payment changes state, so funds are reversed, returned or re-credited accurately and customers are informed through clear API events, webhooks and statuses.
  • Run the full product lifecycle from discovery to launch: problem definition, user research with internal and external users, solution design, PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, delivery with engineering, launch readiness, go-to-market, pricing input, documentation and enablement for sales and support.
  • Work with banking partners and scheme providers to understand rulebooks, cut-offs and scheme changes, and translate them into product requirements. Keep BVNK ahead of regulatory and scheme updates.
  • Define and track the measures that matter, such as exception rates, time to resolve returns and recalls, recall success rates, STP rates, operational cost per transaction, SLA adherence and customer satisfaction. Use data to decide what to build next.
  • Make sure capabilities are built once, on one shared BVNK platform, so every scheme, entity and partner benefits.

What we need from you:

  • Several years of product management experience, including owning complex B2B products in payments or fintech end-to-end, from discovery and design through to launch and commercialisation.
  • Solid knowledge of a product framework you've applied in practice: discovery, prioritisation, delivery, launch, go-to-market and post-launch iteration.
  • Hands-on experience with fiat payment schemes such as SEPA, SEPA Instant, SWIFT, ACH, Fedwire, FedNow, RTP and Faster Payments, and a deep understanding of how payments behave after initiation.
  • Experience with payment operations processes: returns, recalls, rejections, investigations, exceptions and reconciliation. You know the scheme rules, reason codes and timelines, and you know where things break in practice.
  • A track record of building compliance- and operations-heavy products in regulated environments, working closely with compliance, financial crime and operations teams on topics such as sanctions screening, payment holds, RFIs and fraud.
  • Strong technical skills. You're comfortable working with engineers on APIs, ledgers, event-driven systems, payment messaging (ISO 20022, JSON), data models and integrations, and you can reason about technical trade-offs without needing to write the code.
  • Excellent communication skills. You write clearly, present confidently to senior leaders, explain complex topics simply, and keep operations, compliance, engineering and commercial teams aligned.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You bring structure to complex, cross-functional problems and keep things moving.
  • An AI-native mindset. You're an early adopter of AI tools and agentic workflows, and you use them to research, analyse, write specifications and design solutions, including spotting where AI can automate operational work.
  • Bonus: experience building internal operations tooling, case management or workflow products.
  • Bonus: experience working directly with sponsor banks, payment service providers or scheme operators.
  • Bonus: experience with products that run across several regulated entities or jurisdictions (e.g. UK, EU, US).

What you can expect from us:

  • Fair and competitive salary at every stage of your growth
  • Flexible working hours, with hybrid working at its heart
  • A culture built on passionate, growth-minded people
  • A flexible approach to holiday
  • Opportunities to travel to our offices around the world
  • An open and creative environment where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets.

At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.
